\chapter{Return to the Familiar Three-Field Card Cue}
\label{ch:pa-form-card-cue-r4}
\hlchaptermodality{174}

\begin{chapteropening}
\textbf{By the end of this chapter:} \emph{I can use one familiar fictional card to choose the matching old age, phone, and date values, then check a brief recall against the bank.}

Copy one supported three-field card selection and recall the other briefly, outside scored A1 mock credit.
\end{chapteropening}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\pa{ਕ} / \pa{ਖ} (two familiar …)}{ਕ / ਖ (two familiar …)}]{One old card, three old bank choices}

\label{lesson:PA-R174-form-card-cue-again}



\begin{quote}
This is a gentle return to fictional practice values, not a request for personal information or a scored A1 mock.

Keep this old model visible: \textbf{\pa{ਕ}} chooses A in all three banks; \textbf{\pa{ਖ}} chooses B in all three banks. Age A/B are \textbf{\pa{੧੫} / \pa{੨੫}}; phone A/B are \textbf{\pa{੦੧੨} \pa{੨੫੧} / \pa{੦੨੫} \pa{੧੨੫}}; date A/B are \textbf{\pa{੧੫}/\pa{੦੧}/\pa{੨੦੨੫} / \pa{੨੫}/\pa{੦੨}/\pa{੨੦੨੫}}. Point to the matching bank letter for each field before writing anything.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
With the model still visible, use \textbf{\pa{ਕ}} to copy its three A values after these printed labels. Look back at the bank before each value. Keep the card mark out of the form.

\begin{quote}
\pa{ਉਮਰ}: \_\_\_\_\_\_
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\pa{ਫ਼ੋਨ}: \_\_\_\_\_\_
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\pa{ਤਾਰੀਖ਼}: \_\_\_\_\_\_
\end{quote}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Cover the bank for five seconds. The card is now \textbf{\pa{ਖ}}. On a fresh copy of the same three printed labels, write the familiar B values from memory. Uncover the bank and compare one value at a time. If a value differs, correct only that value with the model visible again. This brief recall is practice, not independent timed writing or mock credit.
\end{tcolorbox}
